batch111
Snapshot: candidate 9a8b6927678fc31002c17a133ec00fa8a338cb54; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 6f783e8. Opening and closing gates passed; four new stroke files raw-identical.
Scope: Read completely: current RU guidance and all 3 rubrics; 60 full bodies (4 new kanji lessons EN/RU, 25 EN/RU context pairs, 2 EN-only comparisons); 23 KANJIDIC2 records plus header and 4 radical records; 52 JMdict entries; all 4 KanjiPedia texts; 385 typed kanji rows; 12 proposals, 4 lesson adjudications, 4 clarifications, 4 outside-limit records; all 12 nav diffs. Every requested window returned fully with exit 0; none unread. No web pages read.
C1 CLEAN: The four lessons preserve readings, counts, keys, examples and source distinctions; KANJIDIC2, JMdict and cited KanjiPedia evidence support the claims. Mnemonics are labeled as such. No confirmed Japanese-fact defect.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All 12 nav diffs are only standalone-glyph wrappers to the correct existing ../kanji targets; prose, metadata, Japanese and line-ending context are preserved. New lesson links resolve to existing files; absent RU word pages stay plain text. No direct title collision found for the proposed foils, but active-negative/fallback safety is not established by metadata alone. No transitive guards inferred.
C3 NEEDS FIX: Russian is otherwise clear and the nav wrappers do not impair reading; one sentence in 式 has a malformed/ambiguous list (Finding F1).
N001式→試 S-intro; exact 式 component in 試; meanings differ; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N002式→代 S-intro; shared 弋, distinct full shapes and senses; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N003式→工 S-intro; 工 is a component, craft vs ceremony/formula; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N004引→弟 S-intro; bow-like strokes, pull vs younger brother/pupil; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N005引→強 S-intro; shared 弓 but different right parts and meanings; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N006引→写 U; only a loose shape analogy, not a clear confusing pair from the text evidence; no title collision, ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N007当→帰 S-intro; 彐 appears in different positions; no title/sense collision found; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N008当→白 S-intro; closed 白 vs open-left lower 当; meanings distinct; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N009当→目 S-intro; eye/experience vs hit/right; meanings distinct; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N010形→開 S-intro; shared 开 component, different overall signs and senses; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N011形→研 S-intro; shared 开 component in opposite positions; form vs polish/research; ordinary quiz/fallback U.
N012形→新 U; shapes are distant with no shared component in evidence; no title collision, ordinary quiz/fallback U.
L001式 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: Russian title and ceremony/style/formula examples align with JMdict; KanjiPedia supports attributed 工 + 弋 analysis.
L002引 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: pull/citation examples, readings and 弓 + 丨 analysis supported; mnemonics distinguished from history.
L003当 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: hitting/correctness and 当たる/当てる distinctions are supported; old-form 當 analysis is attributed. Title is a concise contextual gloss, not a sole definition.
L004形 SUPPORTED within introductory scope: form/shape senses and かたち/けい/ぎょう examples are supported; 幵/彡 analysis is attributed.
A001 SUPPORTED bounded: 式 glosses summarize sourced senses; no frequency or curriculum claim.
A002 SUPPORTED bounded: 引く has more senses than introduced; omission is explicit scope, not an exhaustive gloss.
A003 SUPPORTED bounded: 当たる/当てる POS contrast and examples are supported; no frequency claim.
A004 SUPPORTED bounded: 人形 にんぎょう vs ひとがた and separate 形 かた are supported.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT only; 式/形/方/会 share form-method-ceremony domain, not a direct guard; fallback U. O002 LIMIT only; 引/取/出/持 are action neighbors, not direct guards; fallback U. O003 LIMIT only; 当’s correctness sense is near 正 and 本当/真, and 中 shares a reading; no direct guard inferred, fallback U. O004 LIMIT only; 形 and 体 share title word форма and 体 also has かたち; neither is a direct foil, so no guard inferred; fallback U.

Findings: F1 low, C3 — kanji/式.md, Значение и происхождение, opening paragraph: «установленную форму, способ» is an unclear list (comma without conjunction; feminine modifier cannot unambiguously govern masculine способ). Learners may misparse the senses. Fix: «а также установленную форму или способ». Evidence: current Russian sentence and frozen EN «established form or method»; confidence high.
Optional: none.
Limits: No tests/builds/validators run as prohibited. No stroke-image inspection; gate confirmed raw identity only. Standard quiz fallback/runtime option selection remains unverified. English-only comparison pages were read but have no RU versions. No native-speaker or learning-outcome claim.
